description:
Goal

Remove the temporary coverage slack introduced while the behavioral corpus was being migrated. The threshold is construction scaffolding, not a historical resource invariant: restore the strongest floor already supported by the current measured line universe.

Current signal

At 939fdacdf, cargo llvm-cov reported 87,072 covered of 97,750 lines, or 89.0762 percent, and cargo llvm-cov report --summary-only --fail-under-lines 87 passed. Only 11 explicit path deferrals remain across four fixtures. Unrelated functional or diagnostics failures do not justify retaining a lower gate when the coverage report already exceeds the former floor.

Work

Change .coverage-threshold from 84 to 87. After the current matrix invocation is green, verify a fresh coverage report remains at least 87. Do not change fixtures, deferrals, or production code in this ticket, and do not rebaseline downward to preserve an obsolete line count.

Acceptance

The repository enforces 87 percent line coverage and a fresh report passes that gate.
title: Restore the proven 87 percent fixture coverage floor
